description: The player has woken in Aethwyrd (end of the prologue)
The player holds an Adventurers' Guild card
The player has met Brother Caspian and the orphans
The player passed the F→E trial
Grukk, Goblin Chief of Hollowpine, is dead; Whisperwood is Liberated
Old Hollis has trained the player as a Swordsman
The player has seen the mural of nine thrones (Mystery #1)
Early Act III: Lady Nocturne has replaced Mina at the guild counter
Lady Nocturne has been exposed; the real Mina is free
Lantern Night, Act V: Brother Caspian is revealed as the Red Prophet
The player forged a Fangblade for Torvald's guild-wall commission
The player cooked a hearth supper for the orphans of the Small Lantern
The player struck their first pair of runes at Torvald's rune anvil
The guild map shows a safe way to the Salvage Warren's lower level
The Armor Beetle of the Salvage Warren's vault has been felled
The player found the Rune Cistern behind the Warren's secret seam
The guild has ruled on the Salvage Warren's lost-gear salvage
